command.name: post-entry
options: --attestation-custodian <file-pkcs8> --attestation-principal-id <uuid> --attestation-key-file <path> --attestation-passphrase-file <path> (repeat one through 64 aligned credential triplets under the selected custody)
command.summary: Commit a raw direct-journal posting request into the selected SQLite book. Prefer the record-* commands when a typed business-entry command matches the operator's intent; raw direct-journal requests do not admit inventory accounts.
